basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old social media enthusiast from Austin, Texas. My main interest lies in following streams and updates from the Dream SMP community. I'm currently a college student majoring in Digital Marketing and spend my free time exploring new trends in social media marketing. Apart from that, I'm really into improvisational comedy and perform with a local improv group on weekends. I'm single and typically online during late afternoons and evenings after my classes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of social media marketing strategies acquired through my college courses and self-teaching via online resources and communities. I'm also quite knowledgeable about the Dream SMP lore and its community, having followed it closely for over a year.
